resources.string: After clicking the button, the official Google Play purchase window will open. After confirming the purchase, the license will be available automatically.
Google Play has registered the purchase, but the payment has not yet been confirmed.
After confirming the payment, the license will be activated automatically. If confirmation occurs after closing the application, the new features will become available the next time you open it.
The license has been successfully activated. New features are now available in the application.
Google Play was unable to unambiguously confirm the purchase result.
If the payment was successful, the license will be automatically activated during the next synchronization.
Usually the problem is resolved automatically after re-launching the application or a little later. If the problem persists after re-checking, please contact support.
